pages.title: sk
pages.summary: sk is a self-hostable engine for governed workflows: describe the work in plain language, approve what it may touch, and every run is recorded.

pages.title: Use sk from a coding agent
pages.summary: Use MCP for approved sk tools; run sk agent init to declare repository domains and install the Claude Code and Codex hooks that supply shared-memory briefings.

pages.title: sk CLI reference
pages.summary: Every sk command and argument — and the surface authoring runs through: creating or changing a workflow, connector, knowledge source or skill is a definition edit, and definition edits belong here, where the change is a file you can read and a command you can re-run.

pages.title: subkit runtime settings
pages.summary: Every value below lives in canonical runtime configuration and is editable via the Cockpit, HTTP/MCP settings APIs, sk settings configure, or sk settings set.

pages.title: Connector & recipe catalog
pages.summary: What ships in the box: 61 connector templates across 16 categories, carrying 247 recipes — pre-authored, runnable workflows you clone instead of starting from a blank page.

pages.title: Transactional email replies
pages.summary: A Gmail request step may use the explicit transactionaldelivery profile to reply to the address in an original signed request.
